text:
Maya R: heads up — overnight we hit a big embedding spend spike on the Novus onboarding. alert fired at 02:12 UTC. :eyes:
CJ Patel: saw that. dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/dash/novus-usage — looks like bulk doc ingest + repeated semantic_search calls.
Liam O'Connor: is it one user flow or multiple pipelines? any particular model?
Maya R: it's the ingest pipeline + real-time search test suite. top line: ~45M embedding units in ~2 hours from 3 ingest workers. model used: embed-large-v1.
Sasha Nguyen: can we throttle the test suite or put a temporary quota on the onboarding workspace? we should avoid customer-facing regressions but cap background jobs.
FinOps Bot: automated alert: workspace=novus-team, threshold=5M/hr, observed=22.5M/hr at peak, cost_estimate=~$1,800 over 2 hours. Ticket: #FN-5234
CJ Patel: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) throttle ingest concurrency 2) toggle embed-model to v2-small for batch runs 3) enable dedupe & chunking to reduce calls 4) temporary credit while we stabilize.
Maya R: agree. quick check — switching to v2-small for bulk ingest seems low-risk. but semantic_search QA still needs quality check.
Liam O'Connor: can Solutions Eng run a quick sim of cost/quality tradeoffs? we need numbers for the QBR cost slide.
Solutions Eng Bot: running sim on sample dataset (10k docs) with two configs:
```
config A: embed-large-v1, batch_size=256, no-cache
config B: embed-v2-small, batch_size=512, prefix-cache=on, dedupe=on
```
Results: A_cost_est=~$420 (10k docs), B_cost_est=~$160 (≈62% savings), avg_latency_A=85ms, avg_latency_B=95ms. Quality delta: micro-F1 drop ~0.9 points on our semantic eval (likely negligible for onboarding).
Sasha Nguyen: nice. can we sketch an action plan for QBR: call out the spike, mitigations, recommended baseline (v2-small for batch ingest + caching), and ask for a one-time $2k credit during stabilization?
CJ Patel: I'll draft the QBR cost slide. action items: Maya to throttle background workers and enable dedupe (ETA 1h), Liam to approve temp quota change (ETA 30m), SE Bot to run one more sim with real ingest concurrency (ETA 2h), FinOps to log credit request (FN-5234).
Maya R: starting throttle now — `kubectl scale deployment/ingest-workers --replicas=1` and toggling ingest config to v2-small for batch jobs. pinging in #eng-runtime if anything breaks. :zap:
Liam O'Connor: approved temporary quota drop to 10 req/s for onboarding workspace. please document time window.
FinOps Bot: credit request recorded: FN-5234 -> requested_amount=$2,000, status=pending.
CJ Patel: I'll add the cost forecast table to the QBR deck and include the SE Bot sim screenshots. meeting invite for QBR prep in 48h.
Maya R: capturing customer feedback: Novus says they ran heavy synthetic tests to validate search latency. we'll recommend test ramp plan.
Sasha Nguyen: also add an enablement item: best-practice for ingestion (batch size, dedupe, model suggestion) — we can send a short playbook to their engineers.
Liam O'Connor: please upload final slide + playbook to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/CS/QBRs/Novus
CJ Patel: noted. thanks everyone — good containment. :white_check_mark:
Maya R: closing loop after SE Bot confirms final sim. I’ll post a short summary to the customer thread once we have the numbers.
Solutions Eng Bot: final sim with concurrency knobs completed. saved results -> https://app.redwood.ai/sims/novus-ingest-1979990000
Maya R: got it. I'll assemble customer-facing summary and internal QBR slides.
CJ Patel: reaction :thumbsup:
